Callout.Name: Illegal Logging
Callout.Message: Chainsaws and a flatbed working in protected woodland.
Callout.Advisory: Two vehicles, equipment running, no persons confronted.

Script.Line: Two chainsaws and a flatbed, going since about six.
That is protected woodland. There are markers on every tree in it.
They are loading now. They will be gone inside an hour.

Lines.Approach: Two trucks and chainsaws going. They are not supposed to be in there at all.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
